cues: Mobile computing lets the user, the device and the connection all move.
It needs mobile hardware, mobile software and wireless communication.
Each network generation was ten to a hundred times faster than the last: analogue voice in the eighties, SMS on 2G, mobile internet on 3G, video on 4G, and about ten gigabits per second on 5G.
